title: 12-name watchlist · 4 November 2026, 00:00 SGT
summary: Nine watchlist names rose and three fell versus the prior regular close in the individually timestamped active-session snapshots. AMD led at +5.35%; Apple lagged at −2.82%. The 12 completed closes and all 72 return baselines were rechecked and remain unchanged from the 22:00 SGT edition.
coverage_note: All 12 completed closes, 12 individually timestamped active-session observations and 72 adjusted-close return baselines were checked. No new material company development was independently verified among the sources checked for 22:00 SGT on 3 November through 00:00 SGT on 4 November, with overlap of earlier coverage. Company-news coverage is partial because of source-access gaps; this does not establish that no news occurred. Earlier sourced stories and event notices are retained and explicitly labelled below, rather than presented as new announcements.
price_basis: The US regular session was active at the 4 November 00:00 SGT cutoff (3 November 11:00 EST). Main price fields are the last completed regular-session close: 2 November 2026, 16:00 EST (3 November 05:00 SGT), compared with 30 October. Separate active-session snapshots are saved in each stock's research notes, individually timestamped 3 November 10:33–10:59 EST (23:33–23:59 SGT). Source labels these quotes real-time, but this report is a saved snapshot and not live; none is claimed to be exactly midnight. All prices USD; TSM is the US-listed ADR.
return_basis: Cumulative return = 100*(2 November 2026 adjusted close / baseline adjusted close - 1). Baselines for 1–6 calendar months are 2 October, 2 September, 31 July, 2 July, 2 June and 1 May 2026. The 2 August and 2 May anniversaries fall on Sunday and Saturday, so the preceding trading sessions are used. Each of the 72 adjusted-close inputs was rechecked against the attached source URL; vendor adjustments account for splits and dividends/distributions. Before fees and taxes. These completed-close returns are unchanged from the preceding 22:00 SGT edition.
caveats: Active quotes are not synchronized: the observed timestamps span 23:33–23:59 SGT on 3 November, 1–27 minutes before the cutoff. They belong to the active regular session, not premarket or the completed close.

Direct Yahoo page fetches returned HTTP 429. Current search-indexed historical rows, including French and Hong Kong variants, supplied the older adjusted-close baselines. Stale Canadian indexed series were excluded.
TSM 2 September adjusted close is 414.39 in the current Yahoo series, versus 414.62 on Stock Analysis. Yahoo is used consistently for TSM baselines. No change from the earlier edition.

The existing repository schema has no active-quote field. Its price/return fields therefore retain the completed close, the premarket field is null, and active observations are explicitly labeled in the per-stock research.

News review was partial: direct Reuters US markets, technology and autos pages were unavailable. Alphabet, Meta and Micron investor-relations checks were incomplete, and Broadcom investor relations returned HTTP 403. No complete company-news census is claimed.

The earlier 3 November Reuters premarket stories are retained with their original observation times and source dates. They describe the 20:00–22:00 SGT and earlier coverage, not a newly verified midnight development. Overlapping Apple market-reaction notes are combined without discarding their distinct observations or sources.

The previously announced NVIDIA results call was rechecked on its official investor-relations page: 17 November, 14:00 Pacific / 17:00 Eastern, which is 18 November, 06:00 SGT. AMD’s previously announced call is 4 November, 06:00 SGT. These are existing event notices, not newly released earnings.
Existing attributed NVIDIA/Financial Times reporting remains unconfirmed as originally qualified. Preserving it here does not independently confirm the underlying report.
Earlier premarket observations remain in the immutable preceding edition and in the comparison facts in this edition. They are not relabelled as active-session quotes.
Watch only: no holding, executed transaction, user buy call or investment recommendation is implied. Only public research is included; no private diary entries or restricted screenshots are imported.
